name: Daisuki Da Yo -In Spring
source:
Midori Aichi is an ordinary girl who has a crush on Saito-sempai... depending on your choices, you might experience a tangled love triangle or a romance comedy with tsundere sempai....

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27545]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
绿爱知是一个暗恋斋藤前辈的普通女孩……根据你的选择，你可能会经历一段纠结的三角恋，也可能与傲娇前辈上演浪漫喜剧……
